property_summary: For any caller that is the current owner and for any newOwner address, the reference contract allows transferOwnership(newOwner) to succeed (does not revert) and sets owner() to newOwner; the mutant inverts the require to only permit the zero address, causing calls with non-zero newOwner to revert and thus violating this property for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Invert the require to forbid non-zero addresses (only allow setting owner to zero), changing resulting owner after calls.
